Topic 2.1.3: Keeping safe

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Keeping safe. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. observe safety and security in the home environment to avoid risk to self and others
2. demonstrate responsibility towards own safety and security in the home environment. secure in the home.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. observe safety and security in the home environment to avoid risk to self and others
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to observe safety and security in the home environment to avoid risk to self and others. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. demonstrate responsibility towards own safety and security in the home environment. secure in the home.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate responsibility towards own safety and security in the home environment. secure in the home. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Keeping safe.
2. Explain Keeping safe to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.

4. Show that you can: observe safety and security in the home environment to avoid risk to self and others
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Keeping safe. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Keeping safe important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
